findings.judgment: Execution-agent AI-assisted review of current task/README/source and raw analysis only; not independent human approval or an extra model judge.
Immediate per-keystroke writes are correctly treated as the starting behavior to change. Task explicitly requires 120ms latest-only coalescing and later bursts.

README 7-8 explicitly requires accepted departed text through store before navigation returns. This is the literal boundary_persistence predicate, unlike merely eventual audit. No unique implementation is prescribed.

README persistent store across views and save-status comments distinguish retained document text from retired badge output. Contract correctly orders badge retirement before handoff notification, with live badges preserved.
README 6 defines later-started navigation priority and concrete open(C)/close examples inside outer open(B), so the Contract does not invent a precedence rule.
Trailing-task comments and implementation clear pending state before calling work; preserving callback-created later batches is supported, not an inferred cause from a score.

Current edit resolves the selected id at call time for its immediate store write. Preserving document binding when introducing delay is required by README departure ownership; it does not mandate copying unrelated mutable state.

Shared persistent store, requested deferred batches, explicit departure-before-return persistence, entry document binding, inline onSaved navigation and differing record/badge lifetimes are supported by cited docs and source. Required metadata will be derived only from these positive known facts.
Attempt-local cancellation/lazy consumption/async continuation and independent observers of deferred work are not established and stay unknown, rather than being invented or required.

discard_boundary_policy=contradicted applies to the focal document persistence requirement, not the adjacent transient preview; preview discard remains a valid counterexample and is excluded from the maintenance task.

Short owner-expression labels mentioning A/B identify the examples, not exclusive document identities or storage-location policies. No claim overrides the Contract requirement to keep text under its own document key; raw strings are retained unchanged.
